mechanism_claims.claim_text: H4 has source-supported antibiofilm phenotype evidence from MBEC assays; this is activity evidence, not a direct molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm eradication values do not by themselves establish a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: H4 is modeled and described as an alpha-helical cationic hybrid peptide, supporting membrane-activity plausibility without direct membrane-disruption proof in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local paper provides modeling/physicochemical support rather than a direct membrane permeabilization assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Discussion-level membrane targeting or pore-formation wording is retained only as an inferred mechanism hypothesis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No source-reviewed direct mechanism assay, receptor target, nucleic-acid interaction assay, or quantified membrane-disruption experiment was recovered locally.

mechanism_quality_control.overclaim_prevention: No direct_mechanism class is used because local source evidence does not contain a direct molecular mechanism assay.
